Essential Care for healthy teeth and gums

Switch to electric brushing effortlessly with the essential Philips Sonicare 4100 Series. Enjoy up to 700% more plaque removal vs a manual toothbrush

See all benefits

Recommended sonic toothbrush brand by dental professionals worldwide

Gently removes up to 700% more plaque*

Essential Care for healthy teeth and gums

  • Gently removes 700% more plaque

  • Pressure Sensor

  • 3 intensities

  • Easy Start

  • SmartTimer & Quadpacer

Gently removes up to 700% more plaque*

This electric toothbrush comes with C2 brush head. This brush head's power tip is designed to target plaque in hard-to-reach areas and remove up to 700% more plaque than a manual toothbrush.

Sonicare Fluid Action

Philips Sonicare toothbrushes clean gently yet effectively and care for your teeth and gums with 31,000 bristle movements. Sonicare Fluid Action supports the bristles to clean by driving fluid deep between teeth and along the gumline.

Help protect your gums with our pressure sensor

It’s easy to brush too hard, so this Philips Sonicare toothbrush has a pressure sensor with haptic feedback to detect excessive pressure. If you're brushing too hard, it will let you know through gentle vibrations as a reminder to ease-off the pressure to help your gums stay protected.

Better Brushing

We swapped a manual toothbrush for the Sonicare 4100 for my daughter. It has been such a great fit for her routine. The little buzz that lets her know when to move to a new area of her mouth is so helpful for her to start to learn how long she should work in each area and also keeps track of how long she's been brushing. It takes the guesswork out of brushing and helps her actually cover everywhere instead of camping out in one spot. It's lightweight enough that she can hold and maneuver it easily on her own, which has made her so much more independent about brushing. Charging is quick and lasts a long time too, so we're never left scrambling when the battery gets low. It comes in blue instead of the usual black or white, so it stands out on the bathroom counter and there's zero confusion about whose brush is whose. Highly recommend this one for kids (and adults!) who are building good brushing habits! Thanks to the Stellar Product Testing Panel for allowing me to test this out.

Worth the Upgrade

TLDR: Super clean and actually enjoyable. Major upgrade from my spin brush. I had an electric spin style brush that I thought was doing a good job, but I am so glad that I was sent the Sonicare as part of the Stellar Product Testing Panel. My teeth feel dentist level clean. It might sound weird, but I can't stop feeling my teeth. The toothbrush itself feels premium; lightweight but doesn't feel plastic-y. The head is more slender so it is much easier to get to the back teeth. It has timers on it, but to be honest, I don't feel like I really need them anymore. I am brushing longer without them, because I low key enjoy brushing my teeth. I am not one to be effusive in reviews typically, but the tooth brush is worth the upgrade. My husband is actually ordering one for himself right now.

simple and mighty toothbrush that delivers

A mighty toothbrush, don't judge a book by its cover. Your teeth feel absolutely amazing—like you just walked out of a professional cleaning. This toothbrush along with the brush heads delivers that coveted polished, squeaky-clean sensation with zero harshness. It's silky smooth, never abrasive, and leaves your enamel gleaming and totally free from grime and buildup. Seriously, it's that magical moment when your braces come off and you run your tongue across perfectly smooth teeth. That's the vibe every single time. A manual toothbrush will not give you the same result. Vibration toothbrushes are where its at! You can dial in the speed and power to match your needs, and the vibration technology works through buildup like a dream—softening it up so it practically melts away. The intensity of the settings strikes the perfect balance: gentle enough to protect your gums (no bleeding, no irritation), but powerful enough to crush it in those hard-to-reach spots. Pro tip: nail that 45-degree angle, and you're golden. That's the secret sauce with electric toothbrushes. Loved the smart timer and quad pacer feature. Taking the time to brush your teeth is important. It's real easy to not dedicated the right amount to brushing your teeth. it does the work for me which is perfect! It's a solid toothbrush : soft and gentle enough for sensitive teeth and gums, yet tough enough to deliver serious cleaning power, whitening results, and rock-solid plaque prevention. You get the best of both worlds—comfort and performance. Disclosure: I received this product as part of the Stellar Product Testing Panel.

Squeaky Clean Addition to My Brushing Routine

I was throughly impressed by the Sonicare 4100 sent to me by Stellar Panel for testing. In our home we believe in thorough dental care as we have a family history of dental issues, and Phillips Sonicare 4100 fits right in to that routine! First, it’s made by a brand I know and trust Phillips Sonicare, and for my family having a well known quality brand is major. The fact that’s #1 recommended by dental professionals is another point in its favor. Then you have the sleek look and muted light pink color that doesn’t clash with my bathroom counter or walls- it blends in seamlessly. The charging stand is small and doesn’t make the counter look cluttered or overwhelmed, like I said before, it just blends right in. Now for the cleaning benefits, after my first use my teeth felt squeaky clean, like leaving the dentist clean. I loved the added pressure sensor that adjust so I don’t overdo it. Multiple intensities (3) allow me to work my way up to the deep clean that I want gradually over time as opposed to going all in at a high level at once. The Quadpacer is genius as it helps remind me to switch positions of the brush to make sure I fully clean all of my teeth and spend the proper amount of time on each part of my mouth. Add to all this greatness a 14 day battery life with regular usage and it’s a home run addition to anyone’s dental hygiene routine.

Yes, I recommend this product

Brighter Brushing With Phillips

Okay, I have to say, I’ve been really enjoying the Philips Sonicare 4100 Power Toothbrush. I’ve been using it as an upgrade from my regular manual toothbrush, and I honestly didn’t realize how much I’d like having an electric toothbrush as part of my everyday routine. What I really like about it is that it gives you that deep, fresh-clean feeling without feeling too harsh. The Sonicare technology helps clean between your teeth and along the gumline, and the C2 Optimal Plaque brush head is designed to remove up to 700% more plaque than a manual toothbrush. It also has flexible bristles that help with polishing and removing surface stains. The pressure sensor is probably one of my favorite features because I definitely have a tendency to brush a little too hard. If you’re putting too much pressure on your teeth or gums, the handle lets you know so you can ease up. It’s such a simple thing, but it makes you more aware of how you’re actually brushing. It also takes a lot of the guesswork out of brushing. The SmarTimer lets you know when you’ve hit the recommended two minutes, while the QuadPacer helps you spend enough time on each section of your mouth. And if you’re not used to an electric toothbrush, the EasyStart feature gradually increases the power during the first 14 uses, which makes the transition a lot easier. Another thing I love is the battery life. One full charge can last up to 14 days with regular use, so I don’t have to constantly think about charging it. There’s also a reminder that lets you know when it’s time to replace your brush head, which is nice because I’m definitely guilty of forgetting about that. Id say the Philips Sonicare 4100 is a really nice little upgrade if you want to make your brushing routine feel more effective without making it complicated. It’s easy to use, gentle but powerful, and gives you a really clean feeling when you’re done. You gotta check it out.

Yes, I recommend this product

Intuitive and easy to use

I need a soft toothbrush as I have sensitive gums. Usually when a toothbrush is advertised as soft it's still too hard. When I was sent this toothbrush from the Stellar Testing Panel I'll admit, I was leary. I have one toothbrush I can typically use that doesn't cause bleeding or gum soreness. Obviously at first glance this toothbrush is classy and sleek, as far as toothbrushes go. It came already charged and ready to use. This toothbrush has three intensity settings and I can use all three with no sensitivity or pain. It works incredibly well at cleaning the teeth with minimal effort on my behalf. Another handy feature is the pressure sensor. If I'm pushing too hard while brushing it makes a sound and handle vibration reminding me to take it easy. It also has a "smartimer" which automatically shuts the toothbrush off once the two minute brushing period is over. Overall I love this new toothbrush. I've been using it multiple times a day for over three weeks now and I don't see myself going back to my last toothbrush.

Yes, I recommend this product
